name: Malware Scanner by Antivirus.ai – Shieldlume Security
author: Plugins.shop

sections.description:
Shieldlume Security by Antivirus.ai, from Plugins.shop, is a WordPress antivirus and malware scanner with file integrity checks, reviewed recovery, login protection and hardening. Local Free tools need no account or licence key.

Watch the introduction

Try the Free & Pro interface demo | Owner guide | Compare editions

WordPress malware scanner and antivirus checks

  • Resumable scans of eligible core, plugins, themes, uploads and selected database content.
  • PHP/JavaScript heuristics and PHP-in-image checks. Bundled signatures cover harmless EICAR and five exact PHP webshell fingerprints; other variants can be missed.
  • Grouped findings, priorities, evidence and exports. Completed checks, exclusions and unfinished checks stay separate.

File integrity checks and reviewed recovery

After one WordPress.org opt-in, clear official components are compared using checksums or exact-version packages. Ambiguous identities need review. Differences are not proof of malware. Mark as expected binds your decision to a file hash; changed bytes become reviewable again.

Restore official copy uses verified exact-version bytes. Quarantine requires approval and an authenticated encrypted backup. Recovery needs POSIX ownership, Sodium, fsync, private storage and safe atomic publication. Boot/configuration and Shieldlume control-plane quarantine are refused. Owned completed/failed/cancelled backups become eligible for bounded cleanup after 30 days; uncertain, active and unknown records stay retained.

Login protection, 2FA and request firewall

Free includes authenticator 2FA, recovery codes, password-plus-passkey sign-in, administrator policies and endpoint controls. Fresh defaults: five failed sign-ins per account in 15 minutes with backoff; Observe firewall. Review before Block. Upgrades retain choices; conflicts may suspend login limits. Exemptions never bypass authentication or 2FA. Filtering covers supported WordPress requests, not CDN/DDoS protection.

Security hardening and email alerts

18 hardening controls and five audits cover uploads PHP, XML-RPC, file editing, headers and configuration. Apply requires review; Undo removes only owned changes. Header controls check for existing headers, including host/CDN headers, on a same-origin response. The check needs JavaScript; Undo does not. Recheck after host changes. Unsupported actions show manual steps.

Free email alerts/digests use WordPress mail. Separate Pro uses the same scanner, adding automation, investigations, reports, optional AI and browser notifications with separate permissions. Free never downloads paid code.

Related plugins by Plugins.shop

  • Logged.ai – WordPress activity log: logins and site changes. Compatible local integration adds activity context, not proof of causation.
  • ClickClue – session replay: visitor journeys with privacy controls.

Optional tools. More from Plugins.shop.

External services and privacy

Connections require permission/configuration; viewing panels sends nothing. No usage/conversion telemetry. Privacy/operator | Terms. Full retention/withdrawal: docs/privacy-and-services.md, privacy.txt and online disclosure.

  • Antivirus.ai welcome/newsletter: unchecked choices send domain, WordPress/PHP/language, or email/edition to https://antivirus.ai/newsletter-api/v1/plugin-welcome/ . Consented reports refresh weekly or on edition changes; no source/findings/customer records. Email needs confirmation; stop sharing and unsubscribe separately. Sharing privacy, email privacy.
  • WordPress.org: permitted identity/checksum/package jobs send component/version, core locale where relevant, server IP/timing. Comparison stays local; no source upload. Privacy.
  • Wordfence Intelligence: permitted/configured requests use your API credential/server connection, without source uploads. Saving a token does not enable requests. Terms, privacy.
  • Signed indicators: a configured publisher receives protocol/version metadata and server IP for permitted updates, not inventory/samples. Destination/policy appears before enabling. Bundled signatures need no download.
  • Local ClamAV: eligible bytes go to a protected host daemon; the host manages definitions, FreshClam requests and logs. Guidance.
  • Emerging Threats: permitted https://rules.emergingthreats.net/blockrules/compromised-ips.txt downloads normally run every 12 hours. Provider sees server IP/timing, not visitor IPs/content; matching is local. Licence, privacy.
  • Pwned Passwords: permitted supported checks send five SHA-1 prefix characters and server IP/timing to https://api.pwnedpasswords.com , never password/full hash/username/email. Service, privacy.
  • Exposure checks: permitted HTTPS probes contact this site’s public address. Its host/CDN sees selected paths and server IP/timing; up to 512 response bytes are compared transiently, without Antivirus.ai upload.
  • Email: selected alerts/tests send content and recipient through your WordPress mail provider. Acceptance is not confirmed delivery; interrupted/uncertain sends need review.

Logged.ai uses its public local API/route with current viewing permissions, no direct table access/off-site request. Logged.ai controls retention. Free sends no Pro/AI request; Pro services require separate consent/access and cannot approve repairs. Service privacy, terms, AI privacy.

Protect exports/recovery and handle provider records, backups and withdrawals separately. Self-service software, without managed cleanup or response-time guarantees. Support.

Source code and third-party notices

Readable source/assets are bundled. Authentication/QR builds and MIT licences: vendor/auth/NOTICE.md. Space Grotesk OFL: assets/fonts/OFL.txt. Local signature fingerprints and provenance: data/local-signatures.json; no executable specimen is shipped.
sections.installation:
1. Keep backups. Use single-site WordPress 6.8+ and 64-bit PHP 8.1+ on a security-supported branch.
  2. Local POSIX paths are required. Multisite, symlinked components, Windows drive/UNC paths and FTP replacement are unsupported.
  3. Start a scan. Page batches and traffic-dependent WP-Cron resume work; activation starts no scan/provider request.
  4. Review findings and coverage. Opt into official references if wanted; review warnings before Block, hardening or recovery.
sections.faq:
Is the WordPress antivirus scanner free?

Yes. Local scans, file review, supported recovery, account protection and email alerts need no paid key. External services stay off until permitted/configured; WordPress.org comparisons need one global opt-in.

Will scans change my files?

Scans do not alter source. Review recovery separately; back up and check custom code first. Restoring originals can reintroduce flagged code; official restore does not upgrade vulnerable software.

Why can scans have limits?

Structural checks use an adaptive 2/8/16 MiB policy with an override; hashing/streaming are separate. Excluded or unfinished content is not clean. Optional ClamAV has a 2 MiB limit. No malware-free guarantee. Scanner methods.

Does uninstall erase data?

Keep is default. Removal preserves needed recovery keys/indexes and hardening journals. Reinstall can resume sharing; stop sharing/unsubscribe separately. See docs/data-uninstall.md.
sections.changelog:
1.2.9

  • Public sensitive-file checks now continue when WordPress has already queued the next batch.
  • When a worker is busy, WP-Cron retries once and retains completed file results. An administrator can resume a deferred run, or the next daily check can resume it. Turning checks off cancels pending retries.

1.2.8

  • Resolve retained file-content findings only after a safe, explicit absence check; retain the original evidence and show the verification reason. Missing required core files, excluded paths and unsafe or unreadable locations remain unresolved.
  • Record bounded, privacy-preserving sign-in failure and lockout samples without changing authentication decisions. Show the installation’s actual login thresholds and backoff expiry.
  • Validate sensitive-file exposure prerequisites before enabling checks; contain scheduled failures and report unavailable checks honestly.
  • Reject malformed finding filters without broadening the selection. Clarify page-scoped groups, email uncertainty, structural MiB limits, password guidance and local record counts; make manual server instructions easier to open.

1.2.7

  • Show shared header guidance once; preserve each control’s review, checks and safeguards.
  • Add the introduction video; clarify Free features and scan limits.

Earlier history: bundled changelog.txt.
